 Medium

 Print A wedding is supposed to be one of the happiest moments in a person's life. But for one Qualcomm employee in India, the days leading up to his big day brought an unexpected career setback. Just days before his wedding, he reportedly learnt from his manager that he had been selected for a layoff. The employee shared his experience on Reddit , explaining that he had been trying to avoid additional stress while preparing for his wedding. However, uncertainty surrounding Qualcomm's reported job cuts eventually pushed him to seek an answer directly from his manager. His account is among several employee experiences emerging online as the US-based semiconductor company begins implementing workforce reductions in India. While some workers have spoken about the emotional impact of losing their jobs, others have shared details of the compensation they claim to have been offered. A wedding week brings an unexpected career setback
 In his Reddit post, the employee said he was scheduled to get married on November 18. He had already planned leave from November 9 to November 24 to focus on the celebrations and wedding preparations. However, reports of layoffs within the company left him worried about whether his position was at risk. Wanting to avoid carrying that uncertainty into his wedding week, he attempted to contact his manager through Microsoft Teams and phone calls. After receiving no response initially, he eventually managed to speak to his manager and directly asked whether he had been selected for the workforce reduction. According to his account, the manager confirmed that he was among the employees affected and apologised. The manager reportedly added that the company had originally planned to communicate the decision the following week, which would have coincided with his wedding celebrations. Interestingly, the employee said that receiving the difficult news actually made him feel more relaxed because he no longer had to worry about the uncertainty. "Honestly, I am feeling more relaxed after hearing the news than I was before. At least the uncertainty is over, and I don't have to keep worrying about whether I will be impacted or not," he wrote. Another employee shares details of an alleged exit package
 While one employee spoke about the emotional experience of receiving the news, another Reddit user offered a breakdown of the severance benefits he claimed Qualcomm had communicated to affected workers. According to the second employee, his last working day was scheduled for January 31. He claimed that the package included three months' salary, along with an additional month's salary for every year of service. He also mentioned an additional month's pay for employees who signed their separation documents within two to three days. Other components reportedly included earned leave encashment, insurance coverage until January 31 and a bonus dependent on the employee's team. The employee further claimed that affected workers would not receive their annual review ratings, suggesting that the decisions were linked to broader business requirements rather than individual performance assessments. For him, however, the development came at an unexpected but convenient time. He said he had already been considering resigning the following month and that his manager knew about his plans. "Honestly I didn't expect this news. So, fingers crossed till everything lands in the right place," he wrote. It is important to note that these severance details are based on an individual employee's Reddit account. Qualcomm has not publicly confirmed the specific terms, payment calculations or signing deadlines described in the post. What is behind Qualcomm's workforce reduction?
 The reported India job cuts are part of a wider restructuring exercise announced internally by Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon in October 2026. According to a Reuters report published on October 20, Amon informed employees through an internal memo that the company would undertake a global "performance-focused reduction" following its annual employee review process. The notifications were expected to begin in November. The memo reportedly stated that the exercise was intended to strengthen the company's performance culture and address areas where expectations were consistently not being met. Decisions would also consider business priorities, organisational requirements and the skills and expertise needed to support the company's future growth. However, Qualcomm did not disclose how many positions would be eliminated globally. Join conversation

 Reuters reported that the company had approximately 52,000 employees worldwide as of September 2025. Employees face uncertainty as job cuts unfold
 As the reported layoffs progress, employees have increasingly turned to online communities to discuss their experiences, seek clarity and share information about exit arrangements. For some, the financial compensation may provide temporary support while they look for their next opportunity. For others, the suddenness of the decision and uncertainty surrounding their careers have become an equally difficult part of the experience. The two Reddit accounts highlight different sides of the same situation: an employee trying to prepare for a major personal milestone while facing job uncertainty, and another navigating an unexpected exit from an organisation. While the individual accounts offer a glimpse into what affected employees are experiencing, the final scale of Qualcomm's India workforce reduction and the official terms offered to those affected remain unconfirmed.
